title: Crucible enemy roster packet: waves 151-160 (KC2 pack v3.8)

grade_vocabulary.DATAMINED: read from GD's shipped data here (Ed IV .arz via range-audit gdlib.py winner(), CRUCIBLE precedence) or the Ed III .anm census of 2026-08-08 (Ed IV ships no .arc, so clip frame counts and clip events come from Ed III)
grade_vocabulary.PACK: a kc2 pack v3.8 row (id carried: V38-GR2-*, V38-GR3-*, V38-AM3-*, V38-AM5-*, V38-ST1-1, V3-SPEED-REC-*, K1-/K2-SPEED-*, K4-0)
grade_vocabulary.INFERRED: arithmetic or classification by me over labelled inputs; the basis is stated beside the number
grade_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: not established; what would settle it is named

field_grades.e_bodies*: INFERRED (Monte Carlo, 40,000 trials, over the DECODED Lap V count law and PACK v3.8 pools.pool_member weights/limits; per-spawn-point means reproduce Lap V e_bodies within 0.015)
field_grades.display_name: DATAMINED (record `description` tag -> Ed I/III text extract tags_all.json)
field_grades.role: INFERRED from PACK pool_kind (trash / HERO / BOUNTY / DEVOTION / BOSS) + the record's `/nemesis/` folder
field_grades.family: DATAMINED racial profile tags (characterRacialProfile) resolved through tagRaceNNN text; all 466 share `faction_aetherial` (the Crucible's override) so faction does not discriminate
field_grades.actorHeight_m: DATAMINED, but 2.0 is the template default on almost every record; it is not a modelled height
field_grades.mesh_aabb_*_meshspace: DATAMINED (Lap F chunk-10 decode, Ed III Creatures.arc; bind pose, MESH space, includes arms/wings/weapons). Lap F ruled it a FAILED body-size discriminator; humanoid npc meshes read implausibly small (0.42). Do not use as a world height.
field_grades.run_m_per_s: INFERRED: characterRunSpeed x PACK K4-0 (3.209466 m/s per unit; itself INFERRED-WITH-EVIDENCE); the oracle uses the same product
field_grades.anim_prefix: INFERRED where a weapon is equipped (weapon item Class -> GD style prefix); DATAMINED 'unarmed' otherwise
field_grades.clips.*.frames / dur_s: DATAMINED (Ed III .anm header). dur_s = (frames-1)/30, the convention of the EoR and ambush packets; frames/30 is in roster `dur_s_frames_over_fps` of s2 if needed
field_grades.hit_frames / release_frame: DATAMINED (Ed III .anm CallbackPoint events ending 'Hit'); release_frame = first *Hit frame, else first PS*Start frame
field_grades.ability.anim_binding: DATAMINED when the skill's skillSpecialAnimationName resolves through the anim table; INFERRED (class default clip) when the skill has no ref; UNKNOWN when the ref is not in the table
field_grades.gd_fire_range_m: PACK V38-GR2 row (DATAMINED formula ladder[distanceProfile] + r_monster*scale + r_player + 0.5; HI limb)
field_grades.aura_radius_m: PACK V38-GR3 row where corrected, else DATAMINED skillTargetRadius via the range audit
field_grades.projectile_*: DATAMINED (Ed IV projectile record: projectileVelocity, projectileDistance = flight cap, actorRadius = projectile body radius)
field_grades.aoe_radius_m: DATAMINED (skillTargetRadius / projectileExplosionRadius on the skill, its children or its projectile)
field_grades.durations_s: DATAMINED fields named as in GD (offensive*DurationMin = DoT/debuff duration; skillActiveDuration = buff/field; spawnObjectsTimeToLive = pet/field; skillChargeDuration = charge). Rank-dependent arrays are given as min-max
field_grades.vfx_records / clip_vfx: DATAMINED (every records/fx/*.dbr, .pfx and fx .msh reachable from the skill, its children and its projectile, depth <= 3; clip_vfx = CreateEntity events in the bound clip)
field_grades.summons.*: DATAMINED (Ed IV summon skill: petLimit, petBurstSpawn, petPeriod, spawnObjectsTimeToLive)

laws.count_law: Lap V (DECODED Game.dll sub_10357590): one pool per spawn point per wave (weighted SelectPool); champion limb first (championChance), n_ch uniform [cmin,cmax]; regulars n = lo + rand()%(max-lo+1) minus champions; weighted picker skips limit==0 and decrements; empty roster breaks the loop.
laws.p06: p06 (bonus) is OFF in the oracle of record (V11-P06-1). All headline counts are p06 OFF; p06-ON counts are carried beside.
laws.fire_range: GD fire range (centre to centre) = ladder[distanceProfile] + actorRadius*scale + 0.336 + 0.5; ladder Melee 1.25 / Short 4.75 / Moderate 9 / Long 15 / Maximum 18 / Boss 32 m; special slots also gated by the creature's band annulus (edge to edge). Source: range audit L1-L8; pack V38-GR2.
laws.p05_emergence: p05 = ProxyAmbush: bodies absent until +4.0 s, then play their record's spawn clip; during it Attack/Move PENDING, Die REPLACE, damageable (V38-AM1/AM2/AM3).
laws.clip_duration: dur_s = (frames-1)/30 at anim speed 1.0; the record/anim-table speed composition is UNDECODED (RESID-D1-1), so effective playback length may differ where an anim speed != 1 is listed.
laws.speed: m/s = characterRunSpeed x 3.209466 (PACK K4-0); walkSpeed is a separate record multiplier whose world constant is not decoded.

type_definition: a TYPE is one animation rig: the records whose anim table points at the same run clip (idle clip for the stationary plant). Records sharing a type share skeleton and locomotion clips; meshes within a type are visual variants. rig_families groups types whose rig clips sit in one directory AND carry the same bone count (Ed III .anm header): the PC humanoid hero01 (56 bones) and heroine01 (49 bones) sets each span five weapon-style types. Equal bone count is necessary, not sufficient; bone names were not compared.

peak_concurrency.law: A wave ends only when every proxy is AllKilled (pack V10-ADVANCE-1), so waves do not overlap. Ring bodies all appear at t=0; p05 bodies at +4.0 s. Peak concurrent roster bodies on a wave is therefore bounded by the wave's total and reaches it when nothing dies inside the first 4 s (INFERRED). Summoned bodies come on top and are UNCOUNTED.
peak_concurrency.footage_context: The referent's measured living count was 19-36 bodies, median 25 (FOOTAGE, Lap U F-10; legolas/notes/2026-08-14-kc2-pm4-lap-u-ramp-decode/pm4u_findings.md).
